<function name="SetSaturation" parent="Color" type="classfunc">
	<description>Converts a <page>Color</page> into [HSV color space](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV), sets the [saturation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colorfulness) and converts it back into an RGB color.

This is useful to quickly change the saturation of the color without changing hue or luminance, allowing for things like easy theming.
</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<added>2025.01.23</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="saturation" type="number">The new saturation value in range [0, 1]</arg>
	</args>
</function>
